graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FROM kr-topconc-momentum-hunt backlog: C29_Index_Inclusion_Frontrun_Drift = #3 ranked (top_conc=5, mechanism=5, purest exogenous). FULL spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog_topconc.json -> specs[name='C29_Index_Inclusion_Frontrun_Drift']. READ IT and follow build_steps.

WHY THIS NOW (decisive — informed by WT_009+WT_010): buyback discrete-catalyst FAILED because KR 'good-news shareholder-return event' firms are run-up names that MEAN-REVERT (largest buybacks D10 -1.78%/mo, esp 2023+). Index inclusion is categorically DIFFERENT: it is EXOGENOUS — a firm enters K200/KQ150 by crossing a size/liquidity THRESHOLD (committee-driven), NOT by doing something 'good'. So the top decile is NOT a good-news/run-up cohort -> it is the cleanest possible test DECOUPLED from the mean-reversion confound that killed buyback. If even exogenous mechanical-demand events don't translate to KR long-only top-25, that is a very strong characterization.

CONCEPT: Index-inclusion frontrun + drift. Mechanism: forced passive + index-benchmarked buying = mechanical price pressure (Shleifer demand curve; Chen-Noronha-Singal index effect). Each index addition (K200 ~15-25/yr, KQ150) = exogenous binary event. Signal: hold just-added (or about-to-be-added) names in a window around the inclusion, ranked by passive-demand footprint (index weight proxy = Size). Buy-side -> AX-007 escape.

★★CRITICAL PIT (look-ahead trap — getting this wrong FABRICATES the entire alpha): the frontrun alpha lives BEFORE the effective date (arbitrageurs buy on the ANNOUNCEMENT ~2-4 weeks before effective). You MUST trade off the ANNOUNCEMENT date, not the effective date. FIRST verify whether us_k200.parquet / us_kq150.parquet membership flags flip at ANNOUNCEMENT or EFFECTIVE date. If flags are EFFECTIVE-date only, you CANNOT claim the pre-inclusion frontrun (that would be look-ahead) — in that case test only the POST-effective drift (conservative), and SAY SO explicitly. Do not manufacture a frontrun window from effective-date flags.

CONSTRUCTION/GRID: membership transitions 0->1 in us_k200.parquet/us_kq150.parquet (640 K200 transitions verified per spec). Event windows: pre-announcement frontrun (only if announcement dates available), post-inclusion drift {21d,42d,63d}. Cohort = names included within window. top-25 EW (or all if <25). Report which window is PIT-valid.

★LUMPINESS (honest, per spec kr_fit penalty): K200 rebalances ~semi-annually (Jun/Dec) -> ~15-25 entrants/yr CLUSTER 2x/yr -> a continuous top-25 monthly book is SPARSE in non-rebalance months. Report cohort breadth/month. This is likely best as a holding-extended sleeve / overlay, not a continuous standalone book -> report honestly (real-but-lumpy -> overlay/screen route is a valid outcome).

READS: (1) ★is the inclusion drift POSITIVE and does it survive 15bps? net PORT_t. (2) decile/concentration within cohort (highest passive-footprint = D10 — does it carry the drift?). (3) cohort breadth/month + lumpiness. (4) pre vs post window (which is PIT-valid + which has alpha). (5) era stability (index effect may be arbitraged away / weakened over 2005-2026).

ORTHOGONALITY (active -BM): vs M01/M03 momentum |corr|<=0.40, Size <=0.40 (inclusion = large-cap event, must prove not just size-beta), value <=0.35. EXPECTED_ROLE: exogenous event-driven drift overlay/sleeve. PIT: announcement-date PIT (C2/C5), forward Ret, cross-sectional per-month (C1), C13/C14/C15. long-only top-25, [0,0.20], 15bps, 2e8 liq, 2005-01 onward.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 amended): (1) the KR index effect may be ARBITRAGED AWAY / weakened (test era stability). (2) PIT date trap (see above — could fabricate alpha; conservative = post-effective only). (3) lumpy -> not a continuous book (overlay at best). (4) inclusion names are large-cap -> size-beta confound. Graduation NOT presumed; real-but-lumpy -> overlay/screen route. real-computation (canonical_screen_bt) ONLY; Codex Critic Round mandatory. R segfault guard.
